episodes.title: Baltimore Changes Everything
episodes.summary: Assigned to take down a Phoenix crime lord, FBI Agent Nina Hayes targets reluctant getaway driver Jim Ellis – unaware that deeper corruption awaits.

episodes.title: Suspicious Minds
episodes.summary: After grudgingly agreeing to work with Nina, Jim is blackmailed by a corrupt cop, forcing him to make a deal with a dangerous fixer. As Nina uncovers buried FBI secrets, a shadowy figure in D.C. watches her every move.

episodes.title: You're No Good
episodes.summary: Nina and Awan follow a lead that requires tracking down a troubled former agent at a sanitarium. Meanwhile, Jim drives Saxton to a secret meeting that leaves him with growing suspicions... and in search of answers.

episodes.title: Crimunalus Velocitus Super-Sonicus
episodes.summary: After Jim learns that he's being pursued by an assassin, he and Saxton's son Royce are ambushed by rogue thieves while on a high-stakes delivery. Meanwhile, Nina and Awan trace a cryptic message to an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Ravishing Light and Glory
episodes.summary: As a shadowy enemy moves to silence them for good, Jim struggles to reclaim his standing with Saxton, and Nina takes drastic measures to infiltrate the organization. Meanwhile, Jim and Genesis disrupt a mob wedding.

episodes.title: Встречают по одёжке (Meet by the Clothes)
episodes.summary: Jim and Nina help Saxton and Royce negotiate a clandestine deal that spirals out of control. Meanwhile, Izzy leads a protest that could put her in Saxton's crosshairs.

episodes.title: K-129
episodes.summary: Saxton requests Jim's presence in Vegas to meet his mysterious partner, but the trip is interrupted by an unexpected stowaway – and shocking news about Joey's death. Meanwhile, Nina uses Royce's infatuation to her advantage.

episodes.title: 66 Reno Split
episodes.summary: While Izzy secures key leverage, Jim risks everything to save Nina. Then, Jim and Nina uncover the depths of a conspiracy that is more dangerous than they ever imagined.
